title: Large Language Models Meet NL2Code: A Survey
best_for_zh: 希望选择代码生成基准或比较 NL2Code 模型的读者。
one_line: An ACL 2023 survey of LLMs for converting natural-language descriptions into code.
系统梳理大语言模型如何把自然语言需求转换为代码，并比较模型、基准与指标。
why: It helps readers separate model scale, data quality, tuning, and executable evaluation when comparing NL2Code systems.
inclusion_reason: An ACL survey that gives readers a concrete map of NL2Code models, benchmarks, and evaluation limits.

title: Problem
问题
html: Writing a program from a natural-language request is difficult because a plausible-looking answer may still fail to run or miss the requested behavior. This ACL 2023 survey asks how LLMs are being used for NL2Code, which benchmarks and metrics are available, and what a comparison can actually establish. It reviews existing work rather than releasing a new model or code dataset.
把自然语言需求写成程序并不容易：看起来合理的代码仍可能无法运行，或没有实现所需行为。这篇 ACL 2023 综述梳理大语言模型如何用于 NL2Code、可用的基准和指标，以及模型比较实际能说明什么。它回顾已有研究，不发布新的模型或代码数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey organizes 27 LLMs for NL2Code and reviews the benchmarks and metrics used to compare them. Its HumanEval comparison and discussion lead to three factors behind progress: model size, high-quality data, and expert tuning. These are useful comparison lenses, not a guarantee that any one system will solve every programming task.
综述整理了 27 个用于 NL2Code 的大语言模型，并回顾用于比较它们的基准与指标。作者结合 HumanEval 比较提出三个重要因素：模型规模、高质量数据和专家调优。它们是理解进展的比较视角，而不是任何系统都能解决所有编程任务的保证。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature survey. It collects existing NL2Code models, reviews benchmarks and metrics, compares model results on HumanEval, and discusses the gap between current systems and human programmers. The accompanying website is intended to track later work through crowdsourcing; the paper itself does not specify one shared training pipeline.
这是一篇文献综述。它汇集已有 NL2Code 模型，回顾基准和指标，在 HumanEval 上比较结果，并讨论当前系统与人类程序员之间的差距。配套网站用于通过众包跟踪后续进展；论文自身没有给出统一的训练流程。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports an intuitive comparison of existing models on HumanEval and uses the surveyed literature to discuss models, benchmarks, and metrics. HumanEval is useful because it tests generated programs with executable checks, but a single benchmark cannot cover every programming setting or every aspect of a user's intent.
论文在 HumanEval 上比较已有模型，并依据所收集的文献讨论模型、基准和指标。HumanEval 的价值在于能用可执行检查测试生成程序；但单一基准不能覆盖所有编程场景，也不能完整表达用户意图。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The paper presents itself as the first survey of LLMs for NL2Code. Its contribution is not a new generator but a consolidated view of 27 models, their benchmark comparisons, and the claim that scale, data, and expert tuning should be considered together. Reuse its taxonomy to frame a comparison before interpreting leaderboard numbers.
论文将自己定位为首篇面向 NL2Code 大语言模型的综述。它的贡献不是提出新的生成器，而是汇总 27 个模型、它们的基准比较，并强调规模、数据和专家调优需要结合考察。阅读榜单前，可先用它的整理框架建立比较维度。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The conclusions are bounded by the models and evaluations available at the time of the survey. Passing benchmark tests does not by itself establish maintainability, security, or full agreement with an underspecified request. The stated gap between models and humans remains a practical caution.
结论受综述发表时可获得的模型和评测所限制。通过基准测试本身不能说明代码易维护、安全，或完全符合表述不充分的需求。论文指出的模型与人类之间的差距仍是实际使用时的提醒。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Read this paper when selecting a starting benchmark for natural-language-to-code work or when explaining why two code models differ. It is especially helpful for turning a vague comparison into concrete questions about data, tuning, model size, tests, and the definition of correct code.

Use the survey to frame a decision before running a comparison. First state whether the target is short function generation, a broader programming task, or a system that must work with particular libraries and constraints. Then ask which benchmark exposes that requirement, what executable tests actually check, and which model-side factors the cited evidence holds fixed. This prevents a convenient score from silently becoming a substitute for the target specification. The survey is strongest as a map from a practical question to candidate studies and evaluation surfaces; it cannot decide which trade-off is appropriate for an unseen engineering context.

当你要为自然语言生成代码选择起始基准，或解释两个代码模型为何不同，这篇论文很有用。它能把笼统的模型比较变成具体问题：数据、调优、模型规模、测试，以及“正确代码”究竟如何定义。

可在运行比较前先用综述界定决策。先说明目标是短函数生成、更宽泛的编程任务，还是必须适配特定库与约束的系统；再问哪个基准能暴露这一要求、可执行测试实际检查什么、被引证据固定了哪些模型侧因素。这样不会让方便取得的分数悄然取代目标规格。本文最适合把实际问题映射到候选研究和评测面，不能替你决定陌生工程场景中的取舍。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Begin with the model overview and the HumanEval comparison. Then record separately what is measured by the benchmark and what your intended programming setting requires. Treat the three success factors as prompts for investigation, and check the cited primary papers before relying on a particular implementation claim.

For a careful comparison, make one row for each model or study. Record the natural-language task description, the generated code, the benchmark and metric, and the executable test result when one is reported. Next note which of the survey's three factors—model scale, data quality, or fine-tuning—is being discussed, but do not treat that factor as an isolated cause unless the primary study supports that interpretation. A benchmark score answers a restricted question: whether generated code satisfies its stated tests under a given setup. It does not by itself show that the code handles a broader specification, unfamiliar libraries, integration constraints, or a user's unstated intent. Keep syntax validity, test success, and fidelity to requested behavior separate. When choosing a benchmark, compare its task format and tests with the target use case before using its numbers to select a model. When extracting an implementation claim, return to the cited paper for prompts, sampling choices, tools, and evaluation details; this survey organizes those studies but does not replace their experimental record.

可先阅读模型概览和 HumanEval 比较，再分别记录基准测量了什么，以及你的目标编程场景需要什么。把三个成功因素当作进一步调查的问题；若要依赖某个具体实现结论，应继续查看被引用的原始论文。

若要仔细比较，可为每个模型或研究建立一行：记录自然语言任务描述、生成代码、基准与指标，以及报告了执行测试时的结果。再标注综述讨论的是模型规模、数据质量还是微调，但除非原始研究支持，不要把其中一项当作孤立原因。基准分数回答的是受限问题：在给定设置下，生成代码是否满足明确测试；它本身不能说明代码能处理更宽的规格、陌生库、集成限制或用户未说明的意图。应把语法有效、通过测试和忠实实现需求分开。选择基准时，先比较任务形式与测试是否贴合目标场景，再用其数值选模型。摘取实现主张时，也要回到被引论文查看提示、采样、工具和评测细节；综述组织这些研究，但不替代它们的实验记录。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Daoguang Zan, Bei Chen, Fengji Zhang, Dianjie Lu, Bingchao Wu, Bei Guan, Wang Yongji, and Jian-Guang Lou. 2023. Large Language Models Meet NL2Code: A Survey. ACL 2023, pages 7443–7464. https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.411/

Use the ACL Anthology page for the official abstract and citation, and use the survey's model, benchmark, and metric overview to find a relevant primary study. Before applying a comparison, verify the prompt format, programming language and library assumptions, model version, and executable tests used. These choices can change what a score means. The survey discusses 27 models and a HumanEval comparison, but does not turn heterogeneous systems into one interchangeable baseline. A model may be evaluated as a direct generator, with a particular decoding setup, or under a task framing unlike a target application. A test-suite result is evidence about listed cases, not a complete proof of functional behavior. Preserve that boundary in a reading list or design document. This card maps models, datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and factors for investigation; implementation and performance claims still belong to the cited primary paper.

It also helps readers avoid confusing a broad model comparison with an end-to-end software evaluation. Check what the task description asks for, what code artifact is scored, and what the stated tests omit. These distinctions are necessary before moving from a benchmark result to an engineering decision.

Daoguang Zan、Bei Chen、Fengji Zhang 等。2023。《Large Language Models Meet NL2Code: A Survey》。ACL 2023，7443–7464 页。https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.411/

应以 ACL Anthology 页面作为官方摘要和引文来源，并利用综述的模型、基准与指标概览找到相关原始研究。应用某项比较前，应核对提示格式、编程语言和库的假设、模型版本以及执行测试；这些选择会改变分数的含义。综述讨论了 27 个模型和 HumanEval 比较，但没有把异构系统变成可随意互换的统一基线。模型可能以直接生成方式评测，也可能使用特定解码设置或不同于目标应用的任务表述。测试集结果只是在列出用例上的证据，不是对功能行为的完整证明。把本卡用于阅读清单或设计说明时，应保留这一边界。它提供模型、数据集、基准、指标和待考察因素的地图；具体实现与性能主张仍应回到被引原始论文。

它还可避免把广泛模型比较误当成端到端软件评估。应核对任务描述要求什么、评分的代码产物是什么、明确测试遗漏了什么，再从基准结果走向工程决策。
